title: ci: add Gitea Release upload for Linux builds
event_payload:
{"ref":"refs/heads/main","before":"f7603b2d93bd777791ef26a0a75df0d57233063d","after":"20829dda2c951559099d32b5aa66c7baed6abb90","compare_url":"https://git.jr4.in/jR4dh3y/boruthingi/compare/f7603b2d93bd777791ef26a0a75df0d57233063d...20829dda2c951559099d32b5aa66c7baed6abb90","commits":[{"id":"20829dda2c951559099d32b5aa66c7baed6abb90","message":"ci: add Gitea Release upload for Linux builds

- Replace nodejs with curl/python3 for API calls
- Add upload step that creates a per-commit release (tag build-{SHA})
- Uploads danboruthingi binary as a release asset
- Only runs on push to main (skipped for PRs)
